page_note: 该页为报告第6页,标题“Business overview and drivers”,主体是“Exhibit 1 – GS revenue driver dashboard”,由F1–F6六个带边框小图组成的折线图仪表盘,每个小图有自己的图例、纵轴刻度和“Performance indexed to 100”副标题。

panel_names: F4: IB: Overall investment banking revenues

components.evidence: six boxed line panels F1 through F6 under one heading 'Exhibit 1 – GS revenue driver dashboard'
each box carries its own name in the frame: 'F1: IB: DCM revenues', 'F5: ICS: FICC revenues'
each panel has its own legend row, e.g. 'Interest rate (US 10yr)', 'High yield spread (inverted)', 'GS FICC revenues'
legends sit under each plot, below the FY tick row, inside the panel frame
lowest ticks are '25' in F3, '50' in F4, '40' in F6 with no axis break drawn
F2, F3 and F4 print 'FY2008'...'FY2015' turned about 45 degrees
lines carry roughly four points per year but ticks read only FY2008 ... FY2015
time axis labelled 'FY2012', 'FY2013', 'FY2014', 'FY2015' rather than calendar years
faint horizontal rules at each tick level in every panel, no vertical rules
six panels x up to 3 series x quarterly points over 4-8 fiscal years, several hundred plotted points
axes show bare numbers (200, 150, 100, 50); scale only from 'Performance indexed to 100' above the plot

new_components.name: zero_tick_as_dash
new_components.evidence: in F1, F2 and F5 the bottom axis label is printed '--' instead of '0'
new_components.why_it_matters: 最低刻度不是数字,读者需推断“--”代表0才能按比例换算纵轴位置,否则整段线的取值会被系统性抬高或压低。

new_components.name: panel_title_in_frame_gap
new_components.evidence: each panel's border is interrupted at top-left by its caption, e.g. 'F3: IB: Financial advisory revenues'
new_components.why_it_matters: 面板名嵌在边框缺口中而非普通标题行,解析器易把它当边框装饰丢弃,导致取值缺少面板键。

new_components.name: index_base_period_unstated
new_components.evidence: 'Performance indexed to 100' given, but no base date such as 'FY2008 = 100' anywhere
new_components.why_it_matters: 指数基期缺失,同一数值在不同面板(起点FY2008或FY2010)含义不同,跨面板对照读数会错。

new_components.name: transform_noted_in_series_name
new_components.evidence: legend entry 'High yield spread (inverted)' states the series is plotted inverted
new_components.why_it_matters: 该系列数值方向被反转,读出的100不代表原始利差水平,必须连同括注一起报告。

difficulty_notes: 取值最难。全页没有任何数字标签,F1/F5网格间距为50个指数点,5%容差对70这类值只有±3.5,即不到网格间距的1/14;F2跨度到400,单条网格代表100,读195须精确到±10以内。更糟的是三条折线在F3、F5中反复交叉重叠且颜色仅深蓝/中蓝/浅蓝三级,单点归属难辨;时间轴只有年度FY刻度而数据是季度点,想把某个峰值定位到具体季度也只能估算,使读数与标签同时失准。
